_comment: Online recognition with Gemini (docs/CHE_DO_ONLINE.md): the model, the instructions and a short description of each detector class. The app and tool/eval/gemini_compare.py build the same prompt from this file, so the app asks what was measured.
instructions: You see one photo of a meal. List every food that is visible on it.
For each food pick the one class below that fits it best. If no class fits (for example carrot, corn, potato that is not fried, sauce, fruit), use "{other}".
List a class once per food item; two separate pieces of the same food are one item.
Only list foods you can actually see; do not guess hidden ingredients.
Also estimate the grams of each item as served.

com.vi: cơm (cơm trắng, cơm tấm, cơm chiên)

mi.en: noodles: wheat, flat rice or glass noodles

ga.vi: thịt gà hoặc vịt (luộc, chiên, nướng, ức gà)
ga.en: chicken or duck meat, any cooking, including chicken breast

thit_kho.vi: thịt heo kho (kho tàu, nước kho màu nâu)

thit_nuong.en: grilled pork or grilled pork chop

heo.vi: thịt heo khác (luộc, quay, xào, chiên, ba chỉ)
heo.en: other pork: boiled, roast, stir-fried, fried, belly

trung.vi: trứng (luộc, chiên, ốp la, trứng cuộn)

cha.en: Vietnamese pork roll or pork loaf (chả lụa)

rau.vi: rau: rau lá, rau cải, xà lách, bông cải, bắp cải, giá
rau.en: vegetables: leafy greens, bok choy, lettuce, broccoli, cabbage, bean sprouts

do_chua.vi: đồ chua (cà rốt, củ cải ngâm chua)
